models.name: Siamese ResNet50-UNet - LEVIR-CD (building change)
models.description: Trained on 0.5 m aerial imagery of US cities (1024px tiles resized to 256px, ~2 m effective).
models.architecture: Siamese ResNet50 (shared encoder) + |F1-F2| multi-scale difference + U-Net decoder
models.metrics_note: Held-out 'test' split numbers were measured by scripts/evaluate.py at the checkpoint's own threshold (selected on the validation split). 'val' numbers are optimistic.
limitations: Trained on RGB aerial/very-high-resolution imagery down-sampled to ~2 m ground resolution.
NOT validated on Sentinel-2 (10 m) or any other medium-resolution sensor; expect degraded results there.
Output probabilities are not calibrated; do not read them as confidence in a statistical sense.
A detection is an observed appearance change, not proof of construction, damage or illegal activity.

models.name: Siamese ResNet50-UNet - OSCD fine-tune (Sentinel-2 urban change)
models.description: LEVIR-CD checkpoint fine-tuned on 11 real Sentinel-2 city pairs (RGB, 10 m) of the Onera Satellite Change Detection dataset; fed at 10 m/px.
models.architecture: Siamese ResNet50 (shared encoder) + |F1-F2| multi-scale difference + U-Net decoder
models.metrics_note: Pixel-level metrics on the 10 official OSCD test pairs (whole images, 10 m), threshold chosen on 3 validation pairs. For comparison on the same pairs: the starting checkpoint (zero-shot) F1 0.30, spectral change-vector baseline F1 0.24. Small test set (10 scenes): treat differences of a few points as noise.
limitations: Fine-tuned on only 11 image pairs (24 in the whole OSCD dataset); expect weak generalisation to other regions, seasons and land covers.
Trained to find URBAN change (new buildings and roads) in RGB Sentinel-2 imagery; it is not a vegetation, flood, fire or crop-change detector.
Validated on the 10 official OSCD test pairs only (see metrics); no validation on your area of interest.
Output probabilities are not calibrated; do not read them as confidence in a statistical sense.
A detection is an observed appearance change, not proof of construction, damage or illegal activity. Clouds, haze, shadows and seasonal colour shifts can produce false detections.
